title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The integrated protection and basic needs programme in Bekkaa Valley in Lebanon is implemented by Trócaire aims to contribute to Outcome 4.2: Individuals and communities affected by crisis transition from reliance on relief towards independence. Activities and outcome include Establish, train and accompany community Committees in the informal tented settlements; support committees to conduct PCVAs and develop Disaster Risk Reduction plans support committees with and trainer of trainers sessions to improve resilience and preparedness capacity of residents. So, communities adopt measures and approaches which strengthen their resilience to cope with crises and shocks. Programmes are in partnership with Nabad Association for Development and SAWA for development and aid. ---- The principal focus of this outcome is:- Increase the resilience of poor and marginalised rural communities by mitigating and adapting to the impacts of climate change and environmental degradation.- Strengthen disaster risk management processes to protect and strengthen communities’ abilities to face crisis and also to protect what they have - Disaster Risk Management reduces the vulnerability of households and communities to the impacts of climate change, supporting them to adapt to a changing climate and the associated hazards e.g. increased flooding, drought and cyclones etc. Preparedness involves measures to reduce the impacts of these hazards, further contributing to climate adaptation
